<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
FamilySpec(name: str, model_types: tuple[str, ...], canonicalize_weights: Callable, param_specs: Callable, graph: Callable, reference: Callable)
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.families`](/api/evoxc-hf/families/)

Also available as `evoxc_hf.FamilySpec`.

A frozen description of one supported model family.

## Attributes

- `name` · `str` — the `evoxc_hf` family key (`ModelConfig.family`), e.g.
  `"llama"`.

- `model_types` · `tuple[str, ...]` — every HF `model_type` string this family covers, sorted
  (`("llama", "mistral", "qwen2", "qwen3")` for the Llama family).

- `canonicalize_weights` · `Callable` — `(cfg, raw) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]` — the HF
  state dict → canonical `(in_features, out_features)` weight map.

- `param_specs` · `Callable` — `(cfg) -> dict[str, evoxc.TensorSpec]` — the graph-input
  spec of every canonical parameter.

- `graph` · `Callable` — `(cfg, seq_len, batch_size=1, *, pack_plan=None) -> Callable` —
  the `@evoxc.defn` forward pass `(params, input_ids) -> logits`.
  `pack_plan` is an optional `evoxc_hf.pack.PackPlan`: when
  given, the forward unpacks the plan's few packed params inputs back
  into the canonical dict as its first statement (`None` keeps one
  graph input per canonical weight).

- `reference` · `Callable` — `(cfg, params, input_ids) -> np.ndarray` — the independent
  pure-numpy forward used as the parity oracle.
